title: Surety bonds - Funding Programs
claims: SBA guarantees surety bonds issued by certain surety companies for qualified small businesses.
The bond types SBA guarantees include bid bonds, payment bonds, performance bonds, and ancillary bonds.
All performance and payment bond guarantees require small businesses to pay SBA a fee of 0.6 percent of the contract price.
SBA does not charge a fee for bid bond guarantees.
SBA-guaranteed bonds cover contracts up to $9 million for non-federal contracts and up to $14 million for federal contracts.
updateCadence: Updated by SBA as program parameters change; contract limits are periodically adjusted
